newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary Jan-Oct real wages drop 3.9 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Hungary Jan-Oct real wages drop 3.9 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Monthly average real wages at Hungary's non-agricultural enterprises dropped 3.9 percent in the January-October period of 1996 in year-on year terms, the Central Statistical Office (KSH) said on Thursday.
As a comparison, real wages in the January-September period were 4.2 percent lower than in the same period of 1995.
The average net monthly wage in the January-October period was 30,950 forints, up 19.5 percent in nominal terms from the same period of 1995.
KSH figures are based on data from enterprises with more than 10 employees.
